# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 12 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches to Watch

- **River Modern sells 93% of units at median S$3,229 psf on debut weekend** - The private residential and EC markets held momentum throughout H1 2026, with River Modern's 455-unit launch standing out as a strong performer. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-condo-launches-2026/)

- **Dunearn House to open sales bookings on 25 July — first private condo in Turf City in 33 years** - A consortium of Frasers Property, CSC Land Group, and Sekisui House will hold a public preview on 10 July 2026 ahead of sales bookings, with prices starting from S$1.475M. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-set-to-launch-from-s1-475m-first-condo-in-turf-city/)

- **Dunearn House review: indicative pricing from S$2,799 psf with a S$1.1M jump between unit types** - A detailed walkthrough of Dunearn House covers its unit mix, layouts, and site plan, noting a significant price gap between smaller and larger unit types. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-condo-review/)

- **Lentor Gardens Residences (499 units) enters Lentor Hills as latest addition** - Kingsford's Lentor Gardens Residences is expected to offer one of the more attractive entry prices within the Lentor Hills estate. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-new-launch-within-the-wider-market-analysis/)

## HDB Resale Milestones

- **Tampines executive flat transacts at S$1.24M — a new high for the town** - The 31-year-old flat crossed the S$1.2M threshold, reflecting continued demand for spacious executive flats despite ageing leases. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/31-year-old-tampines-executive-hdb-flat-sets-towns-new-high-at-s1-24-million/)

- **SkyOasis @ Dawson records its first verified 5-room resale at S$1.39M** - The July 2026 transaction is the first to appear in HDB's official resale records for this Dawson development; a previously reported S$1.73M deal from 2024 was never reflected in public records. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/skyoasis-dawson-first-5-room-resale-at-s1-39-million-july-2026/)

## Future Housing Supply

- **Gillman Barracks to be redeveloped for public and private housing; 25 of 86 buildings retained** - HDB studies confirm the 40-hectare site will be redeveloped, with eight hectares of forest and 25 existing buildings preserved. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/gillman-barracks-set-to-become-a-new-housing-estate/)

- **About two-thirds of Maju Forest to be cleared for future HDB housing** - HDB will clear 15 hectares of Maju Forest, retaining 8 hectares including a nature trail and freshwater stream connecting to Bukit Timah and Central Catchment nature reserves. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-thirds-of-maju-forest-will-be-cleared-for-future-hdb-housing/)
